inputs.share_count_basis: Issued and fully paid 1,732,711,000 shares at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim note 12). The Employee Option Scheme trust (terminated 27-Sep-2024) sold its last 22,266,000 shares in H1 2026, so no treasury/trust shares remain and issued = outstanding; the only dilutive instrument is a subsidiary option scheme worth RMB1m of H1 earnings, immaterial. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows and there is no non-SBC issuance planned.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash-flow add-back (equity-settled share-based payments, RMB12.457m, a subsidiary option scheme); H1 FY2026 RMB7.081m. No equity-award tax withholding (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 every year). Effectively an SBC-zero filer; rows kept explicit at ~0.08% of revenue.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1721 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-10T03:38Z). Model computed in RMB and converted to HKD at this rate; unsuffixed values are HKD. No A-share or other dual listing exists for a direct parity check; cross-check: HKD peg ~7.80/USD implies USD/CNY ~6.65, consistent with the onshore rate. refresh_price.py does not move this rate -- refresh it by hand at the next update.
inputs.wacc_rationale: RMB flows discounted at an RMB-built rate: China 10y CGB ~1.8%, China ERP ~6.5%, beta ~1.1 for a commodity chemical producer -> cost of equity ~9.0%, plus ~0.5pp for HK-listed small/mid-cap China governance and liquidity -> 9.5%. Net cash, so WACC = cost of equity. Same WACC in all three scenarios: cyclicality and quota/regulatory risk are priced in the scenario flows and the 25% bear weight, not stacked in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB27.9m (6.828 current + 21.065 non-current, 30-Jun-2026) included in total_debt alongside RMB1.8m bank borrowings; lease principal (RMB4.1m in H1 2026) is NOT deducted from flows. Immaterial either way.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows made ATTRIBUTABLE by folding the non-controlling interests' profit share into cash_tax_rate_path (combined tax + NCI leakage driver). NCI took 25% of FY2025 group profit and 37% of H1 FY2026 (NCI equity RMB6,197.5m = 29% of total equity). Combined driver: ~18-20% cash tax on EBIT x (1 - ~28-30% NCI) -> ~42% leakage. Calibration: FY2025 EBIT ex interest (3,943.6 - 38.4 - 1,365.4 = 2,539.8) x (1 - 0.42) = 1,473 vs attributable NI 1,642 less after-tax interest ~31 = 1,611 (FY25 NCI share was lower at 25%); H1 FY2026 EBIT ~1,940 x 0.58 = 1,125 vs attributable 1,027 (NCI 37%). 42% sits between the two. Because flows are attributable, the cash pile is also made attributable: the equity_bridge deducts the NCI's ~29% share of consolidated net cash. NCI is NOT also deducted at book (that would charge it twice).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (component build) with the non-US/cyclical adaptations -- Dongyue is an operating manufacturer (refrigerants, fluoropolymers, organic silicon, chlor-alkali), so the routing table sends it to owner-FCF + adaptations; no prior valuation or memory entry exists. Base year FY2025 (revenue RMB14,355m, EBITDA RMB3,944m = 27.5%, PBT + D&A basis, including RMB38m interest income). Owner FCF FY2025 = reported FCF 2,169.4 (OCF 3,706.5 - capex 1,537.1) - SBC 12.5 - interest income 38.4 = 2,118.6 (consolidated, pre-NCI). Net cash RMB5,567.8m at 30-Jun-2026 = bank balances and cash 6,067.0 - dividends payable 469.5 (FY2025 final dividend declared, paid after balance date and already gone ex) - bank borrowings 1.8 - lease liabilities 27.9. Pledged deposits (304.3) excluded: they secure bills payable. Interest income stripped from the flows because net cash (RMB5.6bn) is ~2.6x the owner-FCF base. Buybacks: none since FY2024. The FY2024 RMB3,456.7m outflow was a one-off off-market repurchase and cancellation of 520,978,000 shares (FY2024 AR note 30, 'Repayment of repurchase existing issued shares'), which is why owners' equity fell in FY2024; it is not a recurring programme; the flat count is a modelling convention, not funded by repurchases. Cyclicality handled by a mid-cycle EBITDA-margin glide (FY2026 ~30% on H1 FY2026 32.9% annualised, fading to a 25% mid-cycle vs an 8-year average of ~22.8%; the quota regime since 2024 has structurally lifted refrigerant profits, which justifies a mid-cycle above the pre-quota average) and a 12x terminal cap (cyclical/commodity).
inputs.cyclicality_note: Historical EBITDA margin: FY18 28.2%, FY19 21.7%, FY20 17.9%, FY21 25.5%, FY22 30.4%, FY23 12.9%, FY24 18.5%, FY25 27.5%, H1 FY26 ~32.9%. The current print is near a cycle high for refrigerants and a recovery for fluoropolymers/organic silicon; base fades it.

H1 FY2026 balance sheet, fair value; dividend income from them is not in the modelled EBITDA path.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: mid-cycle nominal growth. Every trailing CAGR is a cycle artefact (3yr windows start at the FY2022 peak, 5yr windows at the FY2020 trough), so none is usable as a forward rate.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 11.0% vs EPS 5yr 21.5% and revenue 5yr 7.4% -- divergence >30% in both directions; 3yr equity -3.7% vs EPS -17.3% and revenue -10.5%. Driven by the 2020 trough / 2022 peak endpoints and the FY2024 capital transaction that cut owners' equity, not by underlying compounding.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF series = reported FCF - SBC - interest income: FY2020 462, FY2022 1,157, FY2025 2,119 (RMB m). SBC is ~0.1% of revenue so owner and reported FCF CAGRs barely differ; the gap is interest income. FY2021 and FY2023 owner FCF were negative (capex supercycle RMB4.0bn and RMB2.0bn).

base.cash_tax_rate_note: Combined cash tax (~18-20%) and NCI profit leakage (~28-30%); see inputs.nci_treatment.
base.wc_capture_note: Negative: receivables 4,143 + inventory 1,449 - payables 3,443 = ~2.15bn net working capital, ~13% of run-rate revenue; growth consumes cash.
base.narrative: FY2026 revenue ~RMB15.6bn (+9%) on H1 +8% and firm refrigerant pricing; margin fades from ~30% to a 25% mid-cycle by FY2030 as fluoropolymer/silicon pricing normalises.

bear.cash_tax_rate_note: NCI share falls with refrigerant profits (the NCI-heavy subsidiaries earn most in the up-cycle), so leakage eases to 40%.

scenario_narratives.base: Quota-constrained HFC refrigerants (R32/R125/R134a, top-5 >90% share) hold pricing near current levels through the Kigali phase-down, with the new 49kt R32 capacity filling into the FY2026 quota; fluoropolymers (PTFE/PVDF/FKM) and organic silicon recover from the FY2025 trough but stay structurally oversupplied, so group EBITDA margin fades from ~30% (FY2026, on H1's 32.9%) to a 25% mid-cycle -- above the 8-year 22.8% average because the quota regime has permanently raised refrigerant economics. Revenue grows with nominal China industrial demand (~3%). Capex steps down from the New Energy Center/R32 build to ~9% of revenue. NCI continues to take ~30% of profit.
scenario_narratives.bull: Refrigerant prices keep climbing as 2027+ HFC quotas tighten and global (Article 5 and US) demand stays firm despite a possible US phase-down delay; PVDF/PTFE demand from AI, semiconductors and new energy absorbs fluoropolymer overcapacity and the high-end polymer/membrane R&D pipeline (>RMB1bn incremental investment) commercialises. Organic silicon consolidation restores DMC margins. EBITDA margin holds ~28% mid-cycle and revenue compounds 4-6% for five years.
scenario_narratives.bear: The refrigerant up-cycle breaks: a quota reallocation, accelerated phase-down to HFOs, or appliance/construction slowdown in China reverses R32/R410a pricing in FY2027, while organic silicon and fluoropolymers return to the FY2023-24 oversupply troughs (EBITDA margin 12.9% and 18.5% in those years). Revenue falls ~12% over two years, margin troughs at 19% and recovers only to 21%; another safety incident or environmental curtailment at an older Zibo facility adds to it.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 25% (up from the 15% default): earnings hinge on a single regulator's quota allocations, the current margin is near a cycle high, and the group has a recent safety-incident record. Base 50%: quota oligopoly economics persist with normalising fluoropolymer/silicon spreads. Bull 25% (down from 35%): needs both continued refrigerant price rises and an end to fluoropolymer/silicon oversupply -- two independent things going right.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Mid-cycle owner-FCF DCF on attributable flows for a quota-protected but cyclical Chinese fluorochemical producer. Value rests on how long refrigerant quota pricing persists and how far fluoropolymer/silicon margins normalise; a large RMB5.6bn net cash pile (~one quarter of market cap, attributable ~RMB4.0bn) underpins the floor. Terminal value capped at 12x FCF for a commodity-cyclical business.
key_risks_to_valuation: Margin path: H1 FY2026 EBITDA margin ~33% is near a cycle high; every 1pp of mid-cycle margin is worth roughly 4-5% of value
NCI leakage: NCI took 37% of H1 FY2026 profit vs 25% in FY2025; a persistently higher share lowers attributable flows
China quota policy: allocations or an accelerated HFC phase-down can reprice the refrigerant segment within a year
FX: RMB->HKD rate is static in the file and not refreshed by refresh_price.py
